title: QBR segmentation workbook — regional deployments
body:
Purpose:
This workbook is an operational QBR segmentation sheet optimized for renewal prioritization across tier, ICP fit, deployment mode, and region. Intended for Customer Success Managers preparing QBRs and renewal outreach lists. Use as both a live tracking sheet and the canonical source for week-of-QBR prioritization exports.

How to use (quick):
- Fill rows per account (one row = account).
- Update ICP Fit and Deployment Risk weekly; ARR and Renewal Date from finance feed.
- QBR Priority is computed but should be overridden when there is recent intel (exec change, legal hold).
- Use the "Playbook Suggested" column to pick the action bundle for the next 30/60/90 days.

Column headers (sheet columns):
Account | Tier | ICP Fit (0-10) | ARR (USD) | Deployment Mode | Region | Renewal Date | Renewal Lead Time (days) | Deployment Risk (0-10) | Usage Signal (tokens/mo) | Support Alerts (30d) | QBR Priority | Score (calc) | Playbook Suggested | Owner | Notes / Action Items

Scoring model (single-line):
Score = (TierWeight * 0.30) + (ICP_Fit/10 * 0.25) + (RenewalUrgencyScore * 0.20) + ((ARR_rank)/max_rank * 0.15) + ((10 - DeploymentRisk)/10 * 0.10)
- TierWeight: Platinum=1.0, Gold=0.75, Silver=0.45, Emerging=0.20
- RenewalUrgencyScore: 1.0 if renewal in <=30 days, 0.7 if 31-90, 0.4 if 91-180, 0.1 otherwise
- ARR_rank: rank of account by ARR among sheet (1..N) where higher ARR -> higher rank
- DeploymentRisk: technical risk score (10=highest risk to renewing)

Playbook buckets (examples):
- Exec/C-Suite Renewal: create renewal deck, schedule exec sponsor call, pricing/contract team engaged, renewal win play.
- Tech Stabilize & SRE Assist: deploy targeted SRE engagement, hotfix runway, SLA credit discussion if needed.
- Migration / Dedicated Offer: propose Dedicated capacity or Private deployment RTB (talk cost vs latency).
- Expansion Pilot: propose proof-of-value for another product line (embeddings/optimize), pilot discount.
- Low-touch Renew: auto-notify, standard renewal sequence, no exec involvement unless trigger fires.
- At-risk Rescue: immediate escalation, customer success + solutions + engineering deep-dive, paused usage credits.

Sample rows (illustrative, anonymized):
- Apollo Health | Platinum | 9 | 1,800,000 | Private (on-prem) | NA | 2026-04-15 | 33 | 7 | 120M | 2 | High | 0.87 | Exec/C-Suite Renewal + Migration Offer | Priya Shah | Legal review started, fedgov audit coming Q2.
- Nimbus Commerce | Gold | 7 | 560,000 | Hosted | EMEA | 2025-12-03 | 265 | 2 | 45M | 0 | Low | 0.62 | Low-touch Renew | Oliver Grant | NPS +, expansion conversation in Feb.
- Vero Analytics | Silver | 6 | 210,000 | Dedicated | APAC | 2026-02-12 | 305 | 4 | 12M | 1 | Medium | 0.53 | Tech Stabilize & SRE Assist | Diego Ramirez | KV cache issues intermittent; SRE ticket #JIRA-7342.
- Meridian Fintech | Platinum | 8 | 3,200,000 | Hosted -> Dedicated (consider) | NA | 2026-06-30 | 108 | 3 | 220M | 5 | High | 0.82 | Migration / Dedicated Offer + Exec outreach | Maya Chen | VP Eng interested in predictable throughput.
- Solace Media | Emerging | 4 | 32,000 | Hosted | APAC | 2025-11-20 | 251 | 1 | 5M | 0 | Low | 0.29 | Low-touch Renew | Oliver Grant | Consider churn prevention email sequence.

Signals to surface in notes column (checklist):
- Contract amendments pending? (Y/N)
- Legal/compliance blockers (Y/N) + owner
- Recent exec change in account (Y/N) + who
- Billing disputes open (Y/N)
- Active P0/P1 support incidents in 90 days (count)
- Product regressions flagged by QA/evals (Y/N)

Operational guidance for CS leads:
- Weekly cadence: export accounts with Score >= 0.70 as the primary QBR / renewal watchlist.
- Monthly cadence: product + SE rotation for all accounts with DeploymentRisk >=6.
- During QBR prep: attach customer-specific prompt evals and baseline LLM-quality metrics to the "linked_artifacts" field for that row (link to evals page).
- Escalation path: if Score drops by >0.15 in 14 days, auto-tag as "At-risk Rescue" and notify AM + Solutions Engineering.

Filtering recommendations for dashboards (Console exports):
- Region filter (NA/EMEA/APAC) + Deployment Mode filter (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) to prioritize local partners and capacity constraints.
- Tier + Renewal window (0-30, 31-90, 91-180, 181+) as primary QBR grouping.
- ICP Fit <=5 & DeploymentRisk >=6 => technical rescue list.

Change log / notes about this draft:
- v0.1 (2025-11-04) initial draft by Maya Chen.
- v0.2 (2026-01-12) added playbook buckets after CS-ENG offsite.
- v0.3 (2026-03-01) adjusted scoring weights to emphasize tier and urgency.

Open questions for review: list for Friday sync
- Should ARR weight vary by region to reflect APAC pricing differences?
- Add a column for "Committed seats/contracts" vs usage?
- Automate RenewalLeadTime using finance webhook (priority: high).

Appendix: export column mapping to CRM & Finance feeds (field names):
- CRM.account_name -> Account
- CRM.segment_tier -> Tier
- Finance.AnnualRecurringRevenue -> ARR
- Internal.deployment_mode -> Deployment Mode
- Internal.region -> Region
- Finance.renewal_date -> Renewal Date
- Telemetry.avg_tokens_30d -> Usage Signal (tokens/mo)

Contact / owner for this sheet: Maya Chen (mchen@redwood.ai)
